definitions.name: E0D.MOD
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A A B DIV FLOOR B MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a modulo b (floor remainder)

definitions.name: E0D.OR
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A NOT B NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: truth truth -> their disjunction

definitions.name: E0D.PICK
definitions.body: 'T' BIND 2 COLLECT 0 1 T SELECT GET
definitions.note: a b truth -> a when truth is TRUE else b; whole values, any shape (no lane-wise SELECT)

definitions.name: E0D.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: vector -> sum of its numbers (0 for empty)

definitions.name: E0D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'P' BIND P E0D.SUM P LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: vector of numbers -> arithmetic mean

definitions.name: E0D.IOTA
definitions.body: [ 'X' BIND 1 ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 1 SUB
definitions.note: vector -> [ 0 .. n-1 ], its indices (empty for empty)

definitions.name: E0D.MASK
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: values truths -> the values whose aligned truth is TRUE, in order

definitions.name: E0D.ADJ
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: vector (n>=1) -> n-1 adjacent pairs [ v[i] v[i+1] ]

definitions.name: E0D.CHANGES
definitions.body: E0D.ADJ [ 'P' BIND P 1 TAKE P 1 DROP EQ NOT ] MAP
definitions.note: vector (n>=1) -> n-1 truths, TRUE where v[i+1] differs from v[i] (NILs compared safely)

definitions.name: E0D.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 TAKE V 1 DROP V E0D.CHANGES E0D.MASK CONCAT
definitions.note: vector (n>=1) -> runs of equal adjacent values collapsed to one value

definitions.name: E0D.RUNLENS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V E0D.CHANGES 'CH' BIND [ 0 ] CH E0D.IOTA 1 ADD CH E0D.MASK CONCAT 'S' BIND S 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT S SUB
definitions.note: vector (n>=1) -> length of each maximal run of equal adjacent values, in order

definitions.name: E0D.RLE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V E0D.DEDUPE V E0D.RUNLENS 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: vector (n>=1) -> run-length encoding as [ [ value count ] ... ]

definitions.name: E0D.LONGEST-TRUE
definitions.body: 0 [ 'T' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 T SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: vector of truths -> length of the longest run of consecutive TRUE (0 if none)

definitions.name: E0D.TRUE-RUNS
definitions.body: [ 0 FALSE ] [ 'T' BIND [ 'C' 'P' ] BIND C 1 ADD C T P NOT AND SELECT T 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 0 GET
definitions.note: vector of truths -> number of maximal runs of consecutive TRUE

definitions.name: E0D.ARGMAX-KEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R VALUES 'C' BIND C C 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND R KEYS C [ M EQ ] MAP E0D.MASK 0 GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key with the largest value, first on ties

definitions.name: E0D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D E0D.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> its positive divisors ascending

definitions.name: E0D.PRIME?
definitions.body: E0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime

definitions.name: E0D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'P' BIND N 2 P POW DIV FLOOR 2 E0D.MOD STR ] MAP JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 digits as a String without leading zeros

definitions.name: E0D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 130 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C 1 EQ 'D' BIND C C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 E0D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT D SELECT S S 1 ADD D SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer (steps <= 130) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: E0D.FIB-INDEX
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 12 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'X' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer n <= 144 -> smallest k with F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1)

definitions.name: E0D.OPEN?
definitions.body: 'C' BIND '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT
definitions.note: one-character String -> TRUE when it is '(' or '['

definitions.name: E0D.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C E0D.OPEN? SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest nesting depth (max running open-minus-close count, at least 0)

definitions.name: E0D.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND [ 'S' 'OK' ] BIND C E0D.OPEN? 'OP' BIND '(' '[' C ')' EQ SELECT 'X' BIND S -1 GET X EQ 'M' BIND S C 1 COLLECT CONCAT S -1 DROP OP E0D.PICK S OP M E0D.OR E0D.PICK OK OP M E0D.OR AND 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: bracket-matching fold step: state [ stack ok ] and a char -> next state; stack starts as [ '#' ] sentinel

definitions.name: E0D.BOK
definitions.body: [ 'S' 'OK' ] BIND OK S LENGTH 1 EQ AND
definitions.note: bracket state [ stack ok ] -> TRUE when ok and only the sentinel remains (balanced so far)

definitions.name: E0D.BALANCED
definitions.body: CHARS [ [ '#' ] TRUE ] [ E0D.BSTEP ] FOLD E0D.BOK
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly balanced with matching kinds

definitions.name: E0D.BALANCED-PREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS [ [ '#' ] TRUE ] [ E0D.BSTEP ] SCAN [ E0D.BOK ] MAP 'T' BIND T E0D.IOTA 1 ADD T E0D.MASK 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of the longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty one)

definitions.name: E0D.USTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'S' BIND S -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'PR' BIND S -1 DROP S C 1 COLLECT CONCAT PR '()' EQ PR '[]' EQ E0D.OR E0D.PICK
definitions.note: fold step for pair deletion: stack and a char -> stack with the char pushed, or popped when it closes the top

definitions.name: E0D.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: CHARS [ '#' ] [ E0D.USTEP ] FOLD LENGTH 1 SUB
definitions.note: bracket String -> characters left after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: E0D.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: vector -> only its non-NIL elements, in order

definitions.name: E0D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V E0D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: vector with NILs (some present) -> NILs replaced by the nearest earlier present value (first present for leading NILs)

definitions.name: E0D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V E0D.PRESENT 'P' BIND V P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
definitions.note: vector with NILs (some present) -> each present value divided by the largest present value; NILs stay NIL

definitions.name: E0D.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: JSON String with an 'orders' array -> the Vector of order Records

definitions.name: E0D.REVENUE
definitions.body: E0D.ORDERS [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL 0 O 'price' HAS? SELECT ] MAP E0D.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over orders that have a price

definitions.name: E0D.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: E0D.ORDERS 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ E0D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in order of first appearance

definitions.name: E0D.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: String -> its space-separated words (empty tokens dropped)

definitions.name: E0D.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'X' BIND ' ' X 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> joined with single spaces

definitions.name: E0D.CAPITALIZE
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
